summary:
Feature implemented in the repository, but nothing was executed (per instructions), so all new and updated tests are unverified and flake8 was not run.

Changes:
- New monai/data/csv_saver.py: CSVSaver (save, save_batch, finalize) with the specified overwrite=false merge order.
- New monai/data/nifti_saver.py: NiftiSaver (save, save_batch, private static _create_file_basename), writing through write_nifti.
- monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py: added plot_2d_or_3d_image after the unchanged GIF helpers.
- monai/data/nifti_writer.py: default dtype changed from "float32" to np.float32.
- monai/handlers/segmentation_saver.py, classification_saver.py, tensorboard_handlers.py: rewritten as thin adapters over the savers and plot function. New parameters: output_dir, dtype default None, filename (classification), index (TensorBoard).
- Callers updated from output_path to output_dir: examples/segmentation_3d/unet_evaluation_array.py, unet_evaluation_dict.py, tests/integration_sliding_window.py.
- Tests: added test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py; updated test_handler_classification_saver.py to pass filename.

Choices made: classification completion hook is a bound method _finalize_on_completed(self, _engine) so has_event_handler works on re-attach; CSV finalize skips blank rows in an existing file; TensorBoard handler keeps the original error wording; plot tests for single-channel and max-channels-0 use MagicMock(spec=SummaryWriter) to inspect tags.

Lint was checked by reading only: no lines over 120 characters, each edited file ends with a single newline, and commas are spaced. Nothing was committed.
